'''Fletchette Battalion''' was a unit in [[Rusher's Brigade]] during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Named for the [[Flechette/Legends|weapon]], the battalion fought during the [[Battle of Gazzari]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
